reason: A rule bug in build_samples_v21.py: decision 7 (GSE306226 astrocytes) was applied to the whole series, making its firm neurons, microglia and oligodendrocytes (30 arrays) conditional. Fixed to the astrocyte fraction; the build list changes in exactly those 30 rows (CONDITIONAL -> IN, columns state and reason) and nothing else (checked by row-by-row comparison with seal 2's file). No array was read for a result between seals. The held-out list is unchanged.
rule: Build arrays may be downloaded and calibrated; held-out and truth-set arrays are not scored until the atlas they judge is built and its commissioning bars are sealed (L15).

same_series_split_by_donor.rule: these series build from some arrays and hold out others; no sample is on both sides (checked above). Donor IDs are not in their metadata, so donor separation is checked at Stage 1 from the SNP probes: a held-out array whose genotype matches any build array is excluded from testing, by rule. Their held-out rows test new donors in the same laboratory and never count as an independent laboratory (commissioning_sets_v21.csv, counts_as_independent_laboratory).
